CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.agent_may_write_tour_media(object_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  org uuid := app_private.storage_org_from_path(object_name);
  second text := split_part(object_name, '/', 2);
begin
  if org is null or second !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' then
    return false;
  end if;
  return exists (
    select 1 from public.virtual_tours t
      join public.listings l on l.resource_id = t.resource_id
      join public.listing_representations r on r.listing_id = l.id
      join public.agent_profiles a on a.id = r.agent_id
     where t.id = second::uuid
       and t.organization_id = org
       and r.state = 'ACTIVE'
       and r.can_manage_tour
       and a.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
end $function$

helperDefinitions.name: agent_represents_listing
helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.agent_represents_listing(target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.listing_representations r
     where r.listing_id = target
       and r.state = 'ACTIVE'
       and r.agent_id = app_private.current_app_agent()
  );
$function$

helperDefinitions.name: agent_represents_resource
helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.agent_represents_resource(target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.listing_representations r
      join public.listings l on l.id = r.listing_id
     where l.resource_id = target
       and r.state in ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')
       and r.agent_id = app_private.current_app_agent()
  );
$function$

helperDefinitions.name: current_app_agent
helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.current_app_agent()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select a.id from public.agent_profiles a
   where a.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid;
$function$

helperDefinitions.name: current_app_is_platform_admin
helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.current_app_is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.user_capabilities c
     where c.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
       and c.capability = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'
       and c.revoked_at is null
  );
$function$

helperDefinitions.name: current_auth_agent
helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.current_auth_agent()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select a.id from public.agent_profiles a where a.user_id = auth.uid();
$function$
